name: Velkash
summary: The crown of the Crownlands: a walled capital of white stone and steep bridges, built on the bend of the Weavers' River where it widens to a lake.

ruler.title: High Reeve
ruler.current: Reeve Aldara of the White Step
ruler.note: Elected every ten years by the salt-and-harvest council.

districts.name: The White Step
districts.description: Palace hill, seat of the Reeve and the council.

districts.name: The Thread
districts.description: Canal district of weavers, dyers, and markets. The city's name is said to come from the white silk threaded here.

districts.name: The Hollow Mile
districts.description: Beneath the bridges; smugglers, gambling dens, and the black market in banned writings.

districts.name: Censer Quarter
districts.description: Walled enclave of the Censer order. They collect Glimmerborn and old books. No one outside knows what they keep.

landmarks.name: The Broken Moat
landmarks.description: A dry, stone-lined trench from before the Sundering. Kept as a memorial; the Reeve fills it only at Mornath's vigil.

landmarks.name: Solvane's Halo
landmarks.description: The great sun temple crowning the White Step, ringed by twelve brass bells.

landmarks.name: The Silent Bridge
landmarks.description: The only bridge whose stone is never touched by the Glimmer. Crossing it is said to quiet the Weavers' song in a traveler.

conflicts: The Reeve's court and the Censer order clash over how far the Glimmer hunt may go.
The Hollow Mile runs banned texts despite the Reeve's decree.
Refugees from the Ashlands crowd the outer gates, and the city is not sure it wants them.

inhabitants.note: Stonewrights and smiths of the Thread.
Greenwood emissaries and healers, watched warily.
Desert-tongue traders from the Burning Sands.
